Turbo Titans Car Pack and the High Octane Moto Pack drop today. The Turbo Titans pack brings five count'em FIVE new cars, and the High Octane pack introduces motorcycles!

Oh AND -- there are 3 new music tracks in the game. Just for funs.

notes.title: Surprise update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone. Long time no talk. Guess what? 

We have a massive new update for you!

The most highly anticipated, top-secret, frequently asked-for, totally unanticipated update to Beach Buggy Racing 2: Island Adventure is here! BBR2:IA version 2023.08.08 brings a ton of new content and important tuning updates to the core game as well as improvements to the Hot Wheels DLC and two brand new DLC packs (coming soon).

Island Adventure Upgrades

Top of the list of improvements to the Island Adventure base game is the addition of a new character, Commander Nova. Nova is a canine space explorer with a love of adventure and a passion for liver treats. Her Liftoff ability boosts her forward and above the field of competition, opening up new shortcuts on many of the tracks in the game.

In addition, we have two new city-themed racetracks: Octane City and Sun City Strip. Octane City is a towering car-themed metropolis filled with skyscrapers, with a beautiful autumnal park right in the center. Sun City Strip is a neon-lit beach town with wide boulevards perfect for cruising (and street races). Both city tracks feature our new traffic simulator, populating the roads with cars and taxis to avoid or smash.

We also have the addition of two new cars for your racing pleasure — the pumpkin chariot Screamin’ Jack and the sweet-n-speedy Candy Coupe. 

Finally, we've added a number of a number of additional features and improvements, including car horns and an advanced Photo Mode for taking incredible screenshots. Just hit the Pause button, compose your perfect shot, and hide the UI for a share-ready masterpiece! (Requires gamepad controller.)

New DLC and Hot Wheels Boosted

Oh wait, did I say “finally”? There’s more! Steam users will also have the option of two new DLC: the Turbo Titans Car Pack and the High Octane Moto Pack, as well as free improvements to the Hot Wheels Booster Pack.

The Turbo Titans Car Pack injects a powerful shot of adrenaline with a diverse fleet of five incredible vehicles, including an electric supercar, a wasteland hot rod built from an airplane, and a fire truck themed monster truck. Each machine is crafted with a completely unique persona, designed to refresh your game with a variety of new racing experiences and tactics.

The High Octane Moto Pack lets you experience the roar of engines and the rush of wind against your face with high-speed motorcycle racing. Commandeer three unique bikes: a rugged dirt bike, a turbocharged street beast, and a fusion-powered superbike from the future.

But wait, there’s more! We’re adding brand new content to the Hot Wheels Booster Pack! We’ve got two new cars, the twin-tastic Twinduction and Street Wiener, aka the giant hot dog on wheels. Both cars are available unlocked right out of the box. We’ve also added a new Hot Wheels themed racetrack — the space-themed Outer Limit with upside-down tracks and death defying zero-gravity jumps.

Full Changelist 2023.08.08

Beach Buggy Racing 2: Island Adventure Update

 Two new metropolitan tracks: Octane City and Sun City Strip
 Two new cars: Screamin’ Jack and Candy Coupe
 New driver: Commander Nova, with Liftoff ability
 Photo mode feature from pause menu (requires gamepad)
 New spooky theme for Buccaneer Bay
 Powerslide tuning & car balancing
 Added car horns


Hot Wheels Booster Pack Update

 New space themed Outer Limits racetrack
 Two new cars: Street Wiener and Twinduction


Turbo Titans Car Pack (Coming Soon)

 Javelin: This dragster’s streamlined body and powerful engine make it the epitome of straight-line speed.
 X-Stream: A futuristic dune buggy with a flexible open suspension, the X-Stream turns desert dunes into thrilling playgrounds.
 Extinguisher: With the Extinguisher monster fire truck, you'll tower over the competition, combining raw power with a heart of service.
 Killawatt: A sleek electric supercar that hums with power, the Killawatt embodies pure speed.
 Warhawk: Made from the fuselage of an old fighter plane, this rugged three-wheeler thrives in rough terrain.


High Octane Moto Pack (Coming Soon)

 Sandstorm: A rugged dirt bike built for off-road dominance. 
 Blade 1000R: A turbocharged street beast that's all about speed and precision. 
 Pulsar: A fusion-powered superbike featuring magnetic-suspension and a glowing powerframe.

notes.title: Notes for version 08.09.2021
notes.notes:
Hi all!  Hope you're having a great summer.  
This update primarily updates our controller libraries to add support for the PlayStation 5 "DualSense" controllers.  Fixed a couple odds & ends here & there too.  Enjoy!

notes.title: Quickie update to fix that controller bug
notes.notes:
Ah, the joys of PC game development.  After the last update, we received reports of some players having problems with their controllers.  And of course we haven't been able to reproduce those problems ourselves, which makes fixing a challenge....   

But our best guess  is that in the last update, we included the newest SDL (Simple DirectMedia Layer) controller mapping, to keep things up to date and also add support for PlayStation DUALSHOCK 5 controllers.  Our best guess is that the problem is coming from that.

So this update basically just takes that out and goes back to the old version.  Which means 2 things:
[olist]
If you were having problems with your controller after the last update, please get this one and let us know if the problem goes away.
If, after the last update, you were all "Yay! Beach Buggy Racing 2: Island Adventure recognizes the buttons on my superawesome DUALSHOCK 5 controller!!" .....um, sorry, kid, it's back to generic controller mapping for you.
[/olist]
Anyway let us know if this does (or doesn't! ːsteamsadː) fix your controller problems.  If you had them.  

Thanks!

notes.title: Update: Bug fixin' and Paint swappin'
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!  Hope you're enjoying the game so far.  This is our first major update since the game launched.  For the most part we're just fixing bugs and rearchitecting a bunch of stuff under the hood to get ready for a major DLC announcement in the coming weeks.

But don't let that stop you!  This update still has some good improvements, including:

 Physics framerate increased to 120Hz.  Cars should run a little smoother, and fewer collision glitches.
 You can now swap and view unlocked car and driver skins in the Collection info popups, and save your preference.
 Car painting now triggers from inside the info popups.  So, go to the Collection, open the car you want, and paint from there.
 Ghosts are now saved when earning trophies (in Drift, Firework Fury, and Time Trial League Rules) 
 Fixed some bugs, including a nasty crash.


Enjoy!

notes.title: Release Candidate Incoming!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!  

We just pushed out a new build that fixes a few odds and ends bugs and is officially, we think, we hope, the build which we're going to push to Full Release next week.

That's right, March 10, 2021 is the end of the gestational period of Beach Buggy Racing 2: Island Adventure, and the beginning of...its life?  (I dunno where that metaphor was going.)

Thank you again to everyone who has helped play, test, offer feedback and support to our little cadre of developers while we work on this thing.  It's been fun, and we're not done!  We're still getting tons of feedback to sift through, and we are hard at work on our first major DLC expansion which is going to be REALLY MAJOR.  You'll see.  Just wait a little.

Also, if there's anyone who was thinking of getting the game but was waiting for Early Access to end, here's the choice you're looking at:  

Wait until March 10 when the game flips over to "full release" and you get to take advantage of a modest launch discount, or...
Get the game now at full price AND grab that special Early Access car and decal gift before it goes away forever on March 10.


Either way, you win because fun.

notes.title: Version 2021.01.15
notes.notes:
Hi folks!  Been a while.  How's 2021 shaping up for you all?  We here at Vector Unit have been busy as bees, tying up loose ends and tuning, tuning.  I hope you've been enjoying the game.  We have a bunch of small fixes in this update, which you may or may not notice but I'm going to call a few of them out.  

It would be REALLY AWESOME if you Early Access folks can pay attention to these changes and let us know if you spot any issues:

Multi-language font for player names.  Great news, 해단 and Владимир!  We've added support for Russian, Korean, Chinese and Japanese characters to the font we use for player names, so you won't be looking at ???? when you top the leaderboards.  
Car self-righting adjustment.  There was an issue before where the car would suddenly and violently right itself when you were driving sideways (like wall riding an underwater tube).  We've softened that a lot -- but now you sometimes might skid on the side of your car more?  Let us know how it feels to you!
B'Zorp finish line mission easier.  We loosened up the difficulty a little bit on the Telezorp-before-the-finish-line mission.
Like 100 more little things

In case you're wondering, we're quickly approaching the day when we switch from Early Access to full release.  We're trying to squeeze in a few more fixes and get stuff like screenshots and trailers ready before we make it happen.  Feedback and change ideas still welcome!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 2020.12.16
notes.notes:
Have you ever heard people say the last 10% of the work is 90% of the effort?  Turns out it's kind of true.  We're at the point in development where we are testing, finding bugs, fixing bugs, and grinding some of the rough edges down to a slippery-smooth luster.  

The most significant change in this update is this:  We finally got our translations for French, German, Spanish and Italian integrated!  If you're fluent in these languages, let us know what you think of the translations -- turns out there's no word in German for "Cluck-na-do".

Also you probably noticed we changed our versioning system.  Goodbye, EA-whatever.  Hello, 2020.12.16!  Technically we're still in Early Access but this is the first step of getting everything synced for the final release, and date-based versions is how we're doing it going forward.

Here's just a few of the other fixes and changes:
 Fixed simple lighting for Optimized graphics
 Changed time scoring criteria to work off rounded 100th's of a second (and an exact match = success)
 Added smooth loading fade transitions to server images in Tournaments
 Cleaned up screen transition animations in front-end screens
 Paint screen polish
 Trophy and star reward polish
 Career map optimization
 Career fog of war polish
 Fixed sign-in & network check scripting and messaging for Tournaments
 Added Narrow font for longer localized languages
 Fixed squashed UVs on paint cans
 Resetting your game now resets everything (including paints and character dialogs)
 Icicle smash count stats now work
 Car collection stats now work
 Really the list just keeps going....

notes.title: Version EA-5.2
notes.notes:
Folks we are closing in on the end of Early Access.  We can smell it.  The Vector Unit team is feeling that extra burst of energy that comes when you see the light at the end of the tunnel glimmering... although, admittedly, it might be the energy you feel when you think about eating pumpkin pie and gravy and stuff for four days straight.

In any case, we have a pretty sweet update for you.  Not a bunch of fancy-pants, think-they're-better-than you, spectacular big-ticket new features.  Just a little humble polish items here and there, doing their earnest best to make the game better'n'better.
 Stats screen update.  We added a ton of stats to track wins, losses, stars, trophies, broken stuff, and more.  Some of these are going to start at zero, not representative of actual progress.  These will only be completely accurate after resetting the game.
 Lots of HUD polish.  We're now showing the event type, speed/difficulty, trophy criteria, etc. during the pre-game intro cameras, the pause menu, the post-game HUD.  It's pretty neat.  Still need to do that slammin' reward sequence!
 UI informational polish.  That sounds boring, but hopefully you'll appreciate it.  We're just going through the user interface, adding as much info as we can to make the game more intelligible.  Among other things, we added strategy guides for every Powerup.
 Lotsa bug fixes.  So many.

notes.title: Version EA-5.1
notes.notes:
This week we have new achievements, Tournament improvements, and a whole bunch of bug fixes and polish. 

 13 new Achievements.  We've added a bunch of new achievements for the completionists among you, because shouldn't you get something special for obsessively collecting every single car and driver in the game?  
 Tournament UI polish.  Added a total player count, improved error handling for connection timeouts, and more!  We also added support for themed tournaments like "monster trucks only".
 We are trying to track down that bug with gigantic Tournament wait times (18882 days). We think we fixed it?  But it's hard for us to test so please let us know if you keep having the problem or not!
 We now have an icon for the application on the tool bar!  Woot!
 Some characters now have special abilities that match their unlocked skins.  Pizza Cannon anyone?

notes.title: Version EA-4.5
notes.notes:
Ohhhhhh man.  We could tell you about all the super awesome stuff that was going to be in this build, but then our schedule just exploded and it didn't all make it, and telling you about it would probably just make you feel kinda sad, and there's too much of that going around these days, so let's talk about the sorta awesome stuff that actually made it.

But first, some important alerts!

 We had to reformat the ghost car data, so your saved ghosts will be lost.  But that's actually a good thing because it gives you a great excuse to record them again!
 We had to change around a bunch of the unlock and skin mission criteria.  The good news is that any cars or skins you've unlocked will stay unlocked.  The bad news is that some missions which you were close to completing will have to start over.  Sorry, we don't expect to do this again, not on this scale anyway.


OK now the sorta awesome stuff:

 Variable rule sets in Adventure mode.  We thought it would be fun to vary it up and put different game rule sets into the Adventure mode.  You can see the rules over at the right and bring up a little dialog to tell you what those rules are.  We would love to know what you think about this.
 New Car!  Twister is finally ready to be unlocked for your driving pleasure.
 Various bug fixes.


We're about 72% sure that the SUPER awesome stuff will make it into next week's build so stay tuned!

notes.title: Version EA-4.4
notes.notes:
Welcome to the latest installment of our game show "Find That Key!"  This week, we have a special surprise for all you contestants -- we actually have a key!  

The Mr Happy secret Pumpkin Patch is live, for real this time.   There is a secret key to unlock it that you can actually find, and all is good.  The clues have changed as well, so forget everything you thought you knew about key-finding and give it a try.  We're particularly interested in finding the right balance between frustration and fun in this key-hunting-exercise, so try and start fresh and tell us what you think.

 Mr Happy's Secret Pumpkin Patch Key Hunt Take 2.  Yeah sorry about last week.  This time there really is a key.  And a new clue.  Have at it!
 Championship / Quick Event polish.  We added new trophy logic so it's hopefully a little more clear what's going on.  Also a new, prettier Championship screen.
 We sent our robot maintenance crew back into the Biodome to clean up the giant door mess they left last week. 
 Various tuning and bug fixes

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version EA-4.3
notes.notes:
OK folks this is a fatty.  We got your secret Pumpkin Patch, full of mysterious chicanery and the return of Mr. Happy.  We've got your fancy blinged out street series cars with neon underlighting, plus the tuff-cute Baja Buster.  We've got trophies, mission hints... I mean, an SDK update?  What more could anyone possibly want?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36823338/fc044c7199a1f614beea86ce22995d78aebc2f35.png

 Discover the secret Pumpkin Patch hidden somewhere between a nightmare and a dad joke.  You'll have to find the secret key and earn a ton of stars to unlock it, but hey you can do that!
 Mr. Happy makes his triumphant return as the one and only (so far) super-secret hidden driver character in the game.  Can you guess which secret map region he's hiding within?
 New fancy street series cars!  Big Dog, Gran Corsa, Micro EX and Lightning GT are kitted out with neons, colored rims and so much more bling it'll make your eyes bleed with joy.
 And wait!  Another new car, the Baja Buster rounds out our selection with off-road fury and a massive spoiler.
 First pass of trophies for Championships and Quick Events.  You can only win these for Default preset rules.  
 Challenge Hints.  When selecting a car or driver, you can now get little hints telling you which ones have challenges you can complete on the current track/event.  You can also press down on the Left Stick thumb button to bring up collection info right there!
 Paint cans moved!  Be warned that paints and decals you haven’t unlocked yet are probably in different places. You should still be able to get everything you were missing, but you may have to look through tracks you've already explored.  Sorry!  We (probably) won't move them again.
 Oh hey, guess what!  We added an option to the presets that lets you choose duplicate drivers.  So those of you clamoring for an all-Beach-Bro race can finally do it (with a custom preset).
 Update to Steam SDK v1.50

notes.title: Version EA-4.2
notes.notes:
With this release we wrap up the main Adventure mode levels, with the lava-rific Volcano Region.  Also a bunch of usability improvements and bug fixes.  In the coming weeks we'll be adding Tournament play, plus some more cars and special secret sauce.  And then we'll be, um, done?  Well at least for v.1.0.  Stay tuned!

 The Volcano Region brings the pain with hot lava and the Ultimate Cup.
 Mix it up with Random Weather for Quick Event tracks.
 Added rumble on/off toggle for gamepads
 Added scrollbars to all selection grids
 The Preset keyboard now works with regular actual keyboard keys in keyboard mode (why was that so hard?)  We also put in some shortcuts for gamepads.
 Changed a bunch of the smash missions for gold skins.  Now they're more like exploration challenges, less grindy, more fun (we hope?)
 Retuned Firework Fury difficulty because OK we admit it was too hard.
 Plus TONS of bug fixes too boring to list individually!

Keep those comments comin' please, your feedback has been amazing!

notes.title: Version EA-4.1
notes.notes:
Do you smell something funky?  Yes, you're right -- that's the musky stench of Yeti in the newly released Ice region of Coconut Island.  But if you take a deeper whiff ...underneath the Yeti stench, you'll detect subtle notes of brimstone mixed with rose petals and candy corn.  And THAT my friends is the smell of Adventure mode being almost finished!  We have just one more region to wrap up, and then a few little secret surprises and we'll be done.

After that the biggest TBD to go into the game is Tournament mode, and then a bunch of polish, and ... well lets just say it's getting pretty close.  Thanks to everyone for your feedback.  Keep it coming!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36823338/1678eae9dc829e01c80ea2b2451f3301dce53a34.png
New this week:

 Chapter 11 Ice Region has been added to Adventure mode.  
 New driver costumes for Benny, Rez, and McSkelly.
 New cars!  The roads just got a little more furious with the addition of Spearchaser and the Waste Rod.
 Gold car skins and missions added for Cyclone, Grand Prix, Indy, Old Timer, Spearchaser and Waste Rod.
 Change the sort order in the Collection grids.  Now you can sort 'em alphabetically, sort 'em by progress made, sort'em sort'em to your heart's content.
 Added ghosts to Drift and Mine games in Adventure mode.  We liked the ghosts so much in Time Trial we decided to add more.

notes.title: Version EA-4.0
notes.notes:
After more time than we thought it was going to take, update EA-3.8 is finally ready for Early Access prime time... and it's so awesome that we've upgraded it straight to version EA-4.0.

We kinda went through a lot of this in last week's post so we'll just get straight to the point:

 Chapter 10 Wasteland added to Adventure mode.  Let's just get that out of the way right up front.  Battle in the Wastelands, win Clutch and the Interloper armored car, there's sandworms, it's great.
 Massive "Quick Event" update.  You can now quick your way into Races, Time Trials, Drift Attack, Firework Fury, Last Car Standing.... all the game modes can now be quick-played. AND you can create different custom Presets for each of those game modes, and save them.  And we also shipped with a few pre-made Presets to spark your imagination.
 We also added Permanent Effects to the Preset options.... These are special effects you can apply to the whole race. Like giving everybody in the race Police Chase for the entire race. Or Bouncy Tires.  It's a little crazy.  Please let us know what you think.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36823338/e96e2959d95129c3cbc891b112719c67ffc00a9c.png

 Totally revamped Championships.  These should be more or less the final Championship track selections (although there's still more features coming here like trophies and stuff).  And of course you can play your presets with the Championships too.  
 Handicapping is now a thing. Because sometimes you want to play with your Grandma....and you can't beat her because she's too good.  So now you can pick individual handicaps for the better players in your house so the competition stays close and fierce. 
 You can also choose Autothrottle if you want for Player Options on the config screen.
 Time of Day selection in Quick Events.  That's something folks have been asking for.
 New Tracks in Quick Events:  Glacier Gulch, Death Bat Alley and Fire & Ice are all now available.  That's about it for tracks, unless we get a crazy itch in our pants and decide to make another one (but our pants are SUPER not itchy right now.)
 New Vehicle available to unlock: Old Timer
 New Gold Vehicles:  Spookster, Sand Blaster, Interloper, Sandrail, Holeshot
 New alt character skins:  B'Zorp and Clutch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36823338/4a3da3fd235a4644634815a3386c1f3a657b88a1.jpg

 Various improvements/bug fixes like Collection screen is integrated throughout the main UI screens, and your choice on skin selection persists on the config screens. 


Phew.  I think there's probably some other super amazing stuff but I can't remember it right now so let's just say that's enough for a 4.0 and call it a day!

notes.title: Version EA-3.7
notes.notes:
Space...the final frontier.  These are the voyages of Beach Buggy Racing 2.  Its Early Access mission: to explore strange new powerups.  To seek out new drivers and new off-road race cars.  To boldly go where no kart racer has gone before!

 Space region is now available in Adventure.  How'd all those stars get into that tiny little video game?
 Accordingly, Red Planet has now been added to the roster in Quick race.  Get your low gravity on!
 Five-Count'em-FIVE more gold vehicle skins:  Giro 930, Strange Rover, Chomper, Rad Rod, Lambini GT.
 Two new unlockable character skins, Disco Jimmy and Roxy Roller now have fancy new unlockable duds
 Paint Take 2!  OK now  you can actually select and play with your paint scheme.  You can also jump straight to painting from the Collection screen.  And most of the base colors are unlocked.  And we hid 45 secret paint cans which unlock special paints and decals all around the race tracks in the game (roughly 2 per track on average)
 Controller screen finalization.  From the Settings menu, go to Controls and you should see your actual controller (Xbox, Playstation, Switch, etc.) appear, as well as any other controllers you have connected.
 UI vehicle rotation using right stick.  We don't have the visual prompts in there yet but you can now rotate your car on paint and other screens using the right stick on the gamepad.

Significant bug fixes:

 Customized paint jobs are now used throughout the game (you can actually drive with these)
 Fixed several mission tasks

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36823338/938910d0e0b175b63884c6ac02da8a94123d392d.jpg

notes.title: Version EA-3.6
notes.notes:
This build has a lot of changes under the hood, and a few over the hood as well! 

 Graphics Settings.  You can now adjust the basic graphic level for single player and multiplayer screen configurations.  So if you are running on some ancient vacuum tube contraption and you need to turn everything down to "Optimized" you can do that.  Or if you play in the flickering LED light of a Beast and you want to crank 8 player split screen up to Detailed, you can do that too. 
 Screen Resolution.  OK not a new feature but the graphics reminded me to remind you that you can set the screen resolution in the launch options.  See this thread for more information.
 Vehicle Painting.  Now you can click on any car in your collection and customize the vehicle paint.  OK OK I know what you're going to say -- a lot of the paints and decals are locked.  That's because we're going to hide them all around the game so you can discover and unlock them!  It'll be great and totally not annoying!  For now we're just testing the feature.
 New Gold Skins for More Cars.  You can now get gold skins for Baja Bug, Rock Stomper, Lambini, Skull Knocker, Machete and Rhino.
 Input refactoring.  That's a fancy way of saying we changed the way we show button images (like A or ESC or LB) and it should now recognize if you're using an Xbox style controller, or a PS4 or Switch and show the appropriate buttons.  We also kinda changed the way the A/B buttons work on some screens.
 Controller screen.  Still a work in progress but at least now you can see a picture of the controller with some labels.  Nice.

notes.title: Version EA-3.5
notes.notes:
Like the relentless desert sands, our updates continually swirl and build into massive dunes of ... gameplay?  OK I admit that metaphor got away from me.  But really, this is a big one.
 The Desert Region is available in Adventure mode.  Explore the mysteries of ancient buried ruins and unlock the secrets of the pyramids!
 New driver skin challenges for Mikka and Beat Bot.  
 New vehicle gold skins for Sun Dazer, Rally Pro, Sarge, Baja Jumper, Lunar Rover and Mudskipper.
 Revamped car and character config:  Now you can see your skin/paint swaps on the driver and vehicle grids, which means you can show your true colors in 3+ player split screen mode!
 Updated to Steam SDK 1.49.  Because beep beep boop.
 Fixed a bug where some car/driver skin challenge tasks weren’t saving their progress.  Not to worry, just play an event with the car/driver where this happened, and it will fix itself.  Progress is not actually lost.

Plus of course various ongoing polish and bug fixes.  What's that, you say?  We didn't fit that one thing you saw in that place?  Tell us about it in the forums!  We read those and pull tasks out of there every single week.  We love your feedback!  Give us more!

notes.title: Version EA-3.4
notes.notes:
Welcome the super-fancy new gold car skins, unlockable via the Collection challenges.  Complete the missions, unlock the **bling**, and switch to it when you're setting up your race.  

The cars with gold skins (so far) include:
 Beach Buggy
 Dune Jumper
 Bulldog
 Crusher
 Lightning
 Micro


By the way, we're trying to go for a mix on all these challenges, with some being easy and some hard, some grindy and others not.  We really want your feedback!  Are they too hard?  Too easy?  Too grindy?  Not grindy enough?   Most importantly, are they fun?!

Oh and we have some new cars for your driving pleasure:
 Baja Bug
 Rock Stomper
 Rhino
 Cyclone
 Indy


And of course various bug fixes/changes:
 Fixed overlapping characters in selection screens
 Fixed missing strings in Castle region
 Vehicle unlock missions changed dramatically
 Fixed PFX colors in Biodome level

notes.title: Version EA-3.3
notes.notes:
This week's update features new costumes, achievements and a new region in Adventure mode.  Plus we fixed some bugs and stuff.

 Sound the trumpets!  The Castle region has been added to Adventure mode.  
 Oog Oog and El Zipo now have fancy new costumes you can unlock by completing their driver challenge cards.  
 5 new achievements:  Spring Has Sprung, Bought the Farm, Hope You Like Jammin' Too, No Honor Among Thieves, Clean Up Your Room


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36823338/9246484dc73c78766d0d4f029fa75cdb5c1cb298.jpg

notes.title: Version EA-3.2
notes.notes:
When the going gets tough, the tough change skins!  At least that's what our mothers taught us, and now we've brought that invaluable teaching to Beach Buggy Racing 2 with Bonus Challenge Alt-Skin Missions (name TBD).

Explore the Collection to find the challenge criteria to unlock fancy bonus skins for drivers and cars... OK, currently it's only for Leilani and Beach Bro.  But eventually all the characters will have bonus skin challenges, and every car will have a bonus gold paint job challenge. Eventually there will be hundreds of challenge tasks to complete, each leading to a special bonus unlock; this is just the beginning.

As if that weren't enough, there's more!

 Track progress on your Driver and Car Challenges from the Collection screen.
 Start your engines!  Raytona Stadium is now available in quick events!
 Removed localization.  Oh wait, that's a feature we're actually taking away.  The truth is we're developing this game in English, and will re-translate when the game is actually done.  Don't worry, all the existing languages will be re-added, and we'll consider adding new ones as well (I'm looking at you, Russian!)
 Character normal maps.  Wait, they didn't have them before?  Well now they do and they look even more awesomer.
 Changed car config sequence to be driver-first.  Not sure why but it seems to make more sense this way.

notes.title: Version EA-3.1
notes.notes:
The Adventure keeps getting longer and more awesome!  This week we introduce Chapter 6, the Jungle, and a selection of new event types, including Time Trial and special Cup events.  

 Welcome to the Jungle.  You knew we had to go there.  Adventure mode now has 6 chapters.  Eventually the plan is to build it out to 12, plus some side quests.  
 Major Adventure event re-tuning.  We've shuffled a whole bunch of events around (but kept your save games intact.)
 Initial difficulty selector in Adventure.  When you start a fresh Adventure, the game now prompts you which difficulty level you want to start at.  Remember you can always change your difficulty at any time under "Adventure Options".
 Time Trial.  Time trial events are straight up tests of skill, where you race your car for best time with no opponents, no Powerups and no special ability.  Once you complete an event, the game stores a ghost recording so you can try and beat your previous score.
 Achievements!  We're starting to add achievements for you to achieve.   Just five for now: Hot Trick, Leapfrog, Stampede, Keep the Receipt, Pyroclastic Flow
 Chapters -- ok we're calling them regions now -- have a new summary screen so you can easily see how many stars, drivers, upgrades and powerups you still have to collect.
 Dino Jungle is now available in quick events!

notes.title: Version EA-3.0
notes.notes:
With this update we're introducing the first pass of our unlocking system, we've added a swamp-tastic Chapter 5 to Career -- er, "Adventure" -- and we've got 2 new levels for you in quick events.  

WARNING
This build resets everyone's save progress.  We had to reformat the Adventure data, and also introducing the locking system scrambled things up a bit.  Sorry for the inconvenience; this may still happen again during Early Access, but we'll try to firm it up as we get closer to shipping.

Welcome to the Collection screen
Here you can browse the cars and drivers (and more!) you own, and track the criteria that you need to earn the locked ones.  There are a few things you should know about this:
 Most cars are locked at the start.  Since we didn't have an unlocking system before, the cars we released previously in EA were unlocked...but now that's all changed.  We're sorry in advance if Twister was your favorite car.  Going forward we'll be adding cars in their locked state, along with Challenges you can complete to unlock them.
 Drivers are unlocked at the start (for quick events).  We want to allow players in quick events to be able to pick any driver right out of the box.  (Well OK there might be a couple of hidden characters who show up later).  But you still need to unlock them in Career mode.  Is this confusing?  Weird?  Awesome?  Perfect?  Please let us know.  
 You can unlock special skins -- but not yet.  Once you've unlocked a car or driver, you'll eventually be able to bring up a new list of Challenges which unlock a special skin for that car or driver.  But this isn't implemented yet.
 There will be more.  So far we've released 22 cars; the final total will be closer to 35.  Also we're trying to add 1-3 more special characters, which will probably be locked or hidden at the start.  And we have other ideas about other collectables -- but more on that another time.


Other new stuff in this release:
 Career is now Adventure.  Yeah we're still figuring out what to call stuff.  
 Chapter 5 added to Career (I mean Adventure, doh!)  Explore swampy temple walls, battle Oog Oog, and uncover the secrets of the Tiki Temple.
 Two new cars.  Rally Pro and Lunar Rover are now available for unlocking.
 Two new levels.  Tiki Temple and Aquarius are now available in Quick Race and Championships (Random)
 Wipe your save game.  Actually we added this last upate, but we didn't call it out.  You can now clear your save game by selecting "Reset Game" under Settings from the main menu.  You'll be prompted "are you sure?" a couple of times, because yes this really does wipe out all your progress.  Please tread lightly.

notes.title: Version EA-2.2
notes.notes:
Chapter 4 has been added to Career Mode.  Explore foggy marshlands and pirate shipwrecks and unleash the ghostly power of McSkelly (if ye can beat him matey, Arr!)

Oh but that's not all:

 Lots more difficulty tuning, both in quick events and career mode.  We crave your feedback like B'zorp craves reruns of Three's Company!  Please let us know what you think of the various difficulty levels.  
 The criss-crossy swampiness of Misty Marsh is now available in quick events.
 Fixed powerups that get dropped in Junk in the Trunk
 Pfx texture cleanup
 Water surface color fixes

notes.title: Version EA-2.1
notes.notes:
This build introduces some save game format changes!  If you played Career in the last build, you will see some parts of your progress have changed.  You should keep all your stars but you'll have to open star gates and collect car upgrades again.  Just FYI.

Other changes in this build:

 New level!  The piratical Shipwreck Reef is available for your shark infested pleasure.
 New Career Options menu.  Set your difficulty level and see the Powerups you've unlocked in Career mode.
 Career difficulty adjustments.  We're continually adjusting this based on your feedback and our own playtesting.  What do you think?  Is it too easy?  Too hard?  What difficulty setting feels right for you?
 Oh and we changed the words we're using to describe difficulty:  Relaxed, Normal, Hard, Very Hard.  Too literal?  
 New navigation options for Career map.  Zoom out to a higher camera!  Use LB/RB to jump between chapters for quicker navigation. 
 Added arrows to Career map.  
 Separated difficulty and speed in quick event Game Options.  By default the AI gets harder as you increase the speed category (100 HP - 1000 HP) in Championships and Quick Race.  But you can also now separate them in settings so you can enjoy a slow challenging race or a fast easy race.

notes.title: Major Update EA-2.0
notes.notes:
Say hello to Career mode!  ...Well, the first three chapters at least.  This is our first unveiling of the map and gives you a sense of what the career/story/adventure mode is going to feel like.  Over the course of development we'll be adding lots more content to this (and occasionally shifting earlier chapters around).

A few important notes about Career:

 This is a work in Progress!!  That means you may lose save game progress and unlocks while we are still working on it.  Please just have fun with it, and expect that this'll happen during Early Access.
 Drift game added.  Instructions and rules are WIP.  You remember how to drift right?  Tap the brake while turning.
 Firework Fury game added.  Basically a time trial with exploding obstacles.  
 Elimination game added.  Instructions and rules are WIP.  
 Driver Cup challenges added.  This is how you'll unlock drivers for your team in Career.  Right now the story parts are WIP and a little sparse.
 Oh also -- you can play split screen co-op in Career, but it's limited to 4 players.


But wait, that's not all!  There's even more awesome new stuff:

 New car!  The scrappy Bulldog is ready for your driving pleasure.
 Another new car!  Crusher smash good.
  New track!  Enjoy the festive atmosphere of Fiesta Village.
  Another new track!  Arrrrr, test yer mettle on the briny shores of Buccaneer Bay.
 Fixed some graphics micro-stutters to smooth out the framerate
 Desktop DPI awareness to fix blurriness when using a scaled display
 For those who asked, added command line parameters to run in fullscreen exclusive mode.  E.g.  --Exclusive true --Width 1920‬ --Height 1080

notes.title: New Version EA-1.7
notes.notes:
Lots of fixes, tuning tweaks and more in this update.
 New car:  Throw your roll cage around in the stripped-down, souped-up Dune Jumper.
 New track:   Finally you can jump the shark (har) in Shark Harbor.
 Can now turn Character ability to 0 in game settings.  That means you can have a pure driving skillz race with no powers or powerups.  
 Tweaked Balanced powerup mode.  Now with more Balance!
 Reduced speed penalties from breakables.  (Ian and Ralf think we're all wimps).
 Tweaked chances of Double Powerups vs Fast Powerups as the race draws ever closer to its exciting conclusion.
 Added a "Defaults" button to the game settings. 
 The AI can now boost start.  And fail boost starting.  And sometimes do nothing.
 Upgraded to Steamworks SDK 148a.

We also changed some winner-whackers Powerups back to globals.  We're still tweaking all of this so please let us know what you like and what you don't!
 Big Tires - because bouncing is fun
 Donut Tires - because frosting is effective
 Earthquake - because earthquakes are for everyone
 Nitro Car - because bombs


As always we welcome your feedback.  Thanks everyone!

notes.title: New Version EA-1.6
notes.notes:
A number of big changes and experiments this week:
 Snazzy new car, the Sand Blaster is now available for your sand-blasting pleasure.
 Full Powerup customization added for quick events.  You can toggle individual Powerups on/off, as well as whole groups.  Create your own custom game mode like "No Shields" or "Ball ‘n’ Chain Only", or even no Powerups at all!
 You can now fire missiles backward! Hold back on the left analog stick or hold the left shoulder button (L1/LB) to use the look-back camera when you fire, and you can take out a pesky rival behind you. But watch out, the other drivers will be doing the same!
 In Championships, you now have the option to “Keep Last Round Powerups”, and start the next race with an extra edge.
 Tweaked some aspects of the Toughness stat to balance things out and give more importance to tough cars like the Machete, Chomper, or Interloper.
 Characters now have individual 1st place animations on Championship podiums (WIP).


We've made a number of other important changes to the way Powerups work:
 Further refinements to the “Balanced Powerups” setting.
 Powerup charge timers have been re-tuned to work with the “Balanced Powerups” setting.
 Persistent buffs like Shield and Power Vacuum now lock up your Powerup slot so you can’t fill it with another Powerup.
 Your own Hazard Powerups such as Jacks, Oil Slick, and Junk in the Trunk can now affect you on the next lap, so drive carefully!
 Special Powerup bubble types like Double (two bubbles stacked) and Fast (!) become more frequent as the race progresses.


And there are some specific Powerup changes:
 Hamster Ball and Ball ‘n’ Chain now have a bit of extra oomph.
 Power Vacuum no longer lasts until you crash. It has the same duration as the Trampoline.
 Cluck-nado Coop now creates its swarm of chickens when an explosion or missile breaks it.


As always, this Early Access game is a work in progress and we enthusiastically welcome your feedback.  What do you think of the new customization options?  How do you feel about the tuning changes we've made?  Talk to us in the forums!  We read them every day.

notes.title: Version EA-1.5
notes.notes:
The newest update is live, with a bunch of fun and entertaining changes.  Please let us know what you think about the new Powerup tuning -- we're looking for feedback!

 Added new configuration options to Championships and Single Race:  Track Direction:  Say hello to mirrored tracks (or don't)!!  Powerup Rules:  Balanced and Random Chance.  "Random Chance" is the old way of allocating Powerups in races -- it's completely random.  "Balanced" takes into account your position in the race and favors stronger Powerups when you're further behind.
 To elaborate on that a little more:  "Balanced" is now the default Powerup behavior in the game.  We'll continue to tune this to try and optimize for fun and exciting competition.  With Balanced Powerup rules, the bubbles give you Powerups weighted on your position in the race; you'll tend to get more powerful powerups when you're further behind, more defensive and less powerful ones when you're in first.
 Difficulty tuning!  Ludicrous is now ludicrously more challenging, Relaxed is extra relaxing, and the others feel more distinct.
 Respawn behavior changed. Now you (and AI) respawn where you get hit, not where you end up bouncing to.
 "Mushroom Grotto" race track now available.
 Did you just blow the first race of the Championship?  You can now restart the Championship right from the results screen.
 Skip into cameras with A/Enter, B/ESC or Start/Space.
 Fixed Bug where Oog Oog's curse, chicken splats and stuff could disappear when somebody else uses Pickpocket.
 Fixed some issues when running the game on Direct3D 10.0 hardware.
 Fixed the split-screen scaling issue for power-up effects that cover your screen.

But wait, there's more!

 Paradise Beach racetrack added to the Single Event and Championship rosters.
 2 cars added:  The souped-up Lambini GT, and the tire-smoking Rad Rod.
